scope: Fixed-shape operator F+B scheduling study; not a new 64-configuration performance sweep or model step benchmark.

measurement_contract.timing: Synchronized complete operator forward+backward; MAX across ranks per sample, then statistics.
measurement_contract.joint: Same distributed process, same data/seeds/native payload; normal and reverse case order; 10 warmup + 50 measured per order.
measurement_contract.memory: Reset after layer construction; Torch allocator peaks cover validation, warmup, measurements and result setup. MAX across ranks; joint summary takes MAX over both orders.
measurement_contract.sampled_device_used: Post-synchronization samples only; not a continuous physical HBM peak.
measurement_contract.occupancy: Poll idle card groups, check again after 5 seconds, monitor every 2 seconds; reject whole run on any external process. Sub-2-second activity can escape sampling.
measurement_contract.trace: Five warmup F+B then one instrumented F+B per rank; independent baseline/candidate processes. No dropped records. Compute interval union overlap excludes WaitDependency/TriggerEvent and is not hardware utilization.

correctness.lifecycle: Initial backward plus three retained-graph repeats; subsequent backward and two pending forwards consumed in reverse order; exact gradient repeatability.

limitations: Fixed shape and EP=4 performance only.
Allocated does not decrease relative to the saved full-fusion baseline.
Existing BF16/GMM differences versus external reference remain within original tolerance.
Profiler spans are instrumented and not substituted for uninstrumented F+B latency.
No new global default or performance guarantee for other shapes.
